experiment_template.research_question: Does earlier delivery of identical syntax feedback improve GLM repair outcomes within 24 calls at 12K?
stop_conditions: 24 model attempts, 48 tokenizer attempts; zero retries; 1800 seconds per episode.
Infrastructure, source integrity or cleanup failure pauses unstarted dispatches.
USD 0.10 model reserve per episode, USD 1.20 total.

success_criteria.correctness: Full private repair/regression scores; passing patches reproduced.
success_criteria.coverage: 12 terminal episodes, six paired comparisons; retain failures.
success_criteria.integrity: Identical paired initial prompts, common tools and workflow; timing only; context and source audits.
success_criteria.screen: More paired wins than losses, zero new false rejections, at most 20 percent mean token and elapsed increase.

records.falsifier: No final repair gain, false rejections, or unacceptable cost.
records.mechanism: Diagnostics become actionable one workflow step earlier.
records.scope: Three observed Svelte tasks, GLM at 12K, two repetitions; development pilot only.
records.statement: Earlier syntax feedback improves full repair completion under the fixed GLM budget.
